backupNote.label: VBA operations can clear Excel's undo history. Back up important files before proceeding.

brandPurpose.label: Organize data. Speed up repetitive tasks. Make results clear.

extraFunctions.label: Functions
extraFunctions.supertip: Explore HAMU worksheet functions and LAMBDA templates with examples.

guide0.label: 01  Where Do I Start?
guide0.helperText: Select source data, open the appropriate tool and read the description. Check the four-step start guide if you’re using the first time.

guide1.label: 02  Clean Your Data
guide1.helperText: Edit headers, view blanks and repetitions. Protect zeros at the beginning of the codes; check text and number types.

guide2.label: 03  Turn Lists into Results
guide2.helperText: Combine the same structured lists, match with common key; Convert data structure with group, Pivot and Unpivot.

guide3.label: 04  Manage Your Files
guide3.helperText: Get a backup with date and time first. Select folder inventory, appropriate stream for data collection and template transfer from files.

guide4.label: 05  Images and Codes
guide4.helperText: Learn the options of adding pictures into the cell or above. Read internet and data sharing information in barcode and square code production.

internetNote.label: Barcode and QR content is sent to a third-party internet service for generation.

openLambdaTemplates.label: Open Template
openLambdaTemplates.supertip: Open the template containing three expert LAMBDA functions. Use Transfer Wizard to copy them into your workbook.

quick_HAMU_About.label: About
quick_HAMU_About.supertip: Show HAMU Tools V1, Hüseyin Avni UZUN and the website, GitHub and email links.

quick_HAMU_AutoFit.label: Fit Height
quick_HAMU_AutoFit.supertip: Fit row heights to selected content without changing column widths.

quick_HAMU_AutoTable.label:
Quick
Table
quick_HAMU_AutoTable.supertip: Create an Excel table from a header/data range and apply a consistent table style. A single selected cell uses its current data region.

quick_HAMU_CheckDates.label: Check Dates
quick_HAMU_CheckDates.supertip: Inspect date values for invalid or inconsistent entries.

quick_HAMU_CleanData.label:
Clean
Trim
quick_HAMU_CleanData.supertip: Clean redundant spaces and invisible characters while preserving Turkish characters.

quick_HAMU_DatePicker.label: Pick Date
quick_HAMU_DatePicker.supertip: Choose a date and write it to the previously selected active cell. Select month/year and see the distance from today.

quick_HAMU_DynamicValidation.label: Dynamic Validation List
quick_HAMU_DynamicValidation.supertip: Create list validation using a named range, Table[Column], direct range or spilled range such as A1#. Table/spill sources can expand dynamically.

quick_HAMU_FixDates.label: Fix Dates
quick_HAMU_FixDates.supertip: Normalize suitable date values and review values that cannot be converted.

quick_HAMU_Help.label: Help
quick_HAMU_Help.supertip: Open the usage guide with workflows, selection/output explanations, limitations and the complete tool catalog.

quick_HAMU_HighlightDuplicates.label: Highlight Duplicates
quick_HAMU_HighlightDuplicates.supertip: Highlight repeated values within the selected area.

quick_HAMU_MarkProblemCells.label:
Problem
Cells
quick_HAMU_MarkProblemCells.supertip: Highlight cells with the problems selected in the dialog.

quick_HAMU_RegexReplace.label: Replace by Regular Expression
quick_HAMU_RegexReplace.supertip: Replace matching text using a regular expression. Capture groups and references such as $1 can be used.

quick_HAMU_ResizeTable.label: Expand Table
quick_HAMU_ResizeTable.supertip: Include adjacent data rows below the table.

quick_HAMU_SelectionToPNG.label: Save Image
quick_HAMU_SelectionToPNG.supertip: Save the selected range as PNG, JPG or GIF. Reject oversized images and clean up the temporary chart.

quick_HAMU_SheetIndex.label: Sheet Index
quick_HAMU_SheetIndex.supertip: Create a worksheet index with hyperlinks to the workbook's sheets.

quick_HAMU_TextCase.label: Change Case
quick_HAMU_TextCase.supertip: Choose uppercase, lowercase or title case from a simple selection dialog.

r_HAMU_AddDateToFilename.label: Dated Version
r_HAMU_AddDateToFilename.supertip: Create a timestamped copy in the original folder. Open and verify the copy before closing and deleting the original; keep the original if verification fails.

r_HAMU_AddDuplicateCount.label: Write Duplicate Counts
r_HAMU_AddDuplicateCount.supertip: Count occurrences of each input value and write the counts to a separately selected output range. A single output cell defines the starting point.

r_HAMU_AddTextAffixes.label: Add Prefix or Suffix
r_HAMU_AddTextAffixes.supertip: Add text before or after values and write to a separate output range. Preserve the source and leading zeros.

r_HAMU_AppendSelectedTables.label: Combine Tables
r_HAMU_AppendSelectedTables.supertip: Combine rows from selected Excel tables with matching structures into one result table.

r_HAMU_Backup.label: Create Backup
r_HAMU_Backup.supertip: Save a timestamped copy to the backup folder configured in Settings. The result displays its full path and an Open Folder button.

r_HAMU_BreakLinks.label: Break External Links
r_HAMU_BreakLinks.supertip: Break external Excel links. Linked formulas may become values; back up the workbook before proceeding.

r_HAMU_ClearHighlights.label: Clear Highlights
r_HAMU_ClearHighlights.supertip: Remove HAMU highlights in the selection. Restore prior fills in the same session; older highlights are recognized by their yellow/orange palette.

r_HAMU_CollectFilesData.label: Collect Files
r_HAMU_CollectFilesData.supertip: Read the first data sheet from Excel/CSV files in a folder and append matching headers. Add the source filename without changing source files.

r_HAMU_CombineCSVs.label: Combine CSV Files
r_HAMU_CombineCSVs.supertip: Append CSV files from a folder to one sheet. Keep the first file's header and skip header rows in subsequent files.

r_HAMU_CompareTwoLists.label: Compare Lists
r_HAMU_CompareTwoLists.supertip: Compare values in two lists and report matches and differences.

r_HAMU_ConsolidateSheets.label: Combine Sheets
r_HAMU_ConsolidateSheets.supertip: Append used ranges from worksheets in the active workbook and add the source worksheet name to the results.

r_HAMU_ConvertColumnTypes.label: Convert Types
r_HAMU_ConvertColumnTypes.supertip: Convert selected columns to the requested data types. Review mixed values and conversion errors.

r_HAMU_ConvertFormulasToValues.label: Formulas to Values
r_HAMU_ConvertFormulasToValues.supertip: Replace selected formulas with their current calculated results.

r_HAMU_ConvertQuotedNumbers.label: Convert Text Numbers
r_HAMU_ConvertQuotedNumbers.supertip: Convert suitable numbers stored as text to numeric values. Review decimal and thousands separators.

r_HAMU_CopyVisibleTable.label: Copy Visible Rows
r_HAMU_CopyVisibleTable.supertip: Copy visible filtered records into a standalone table on a new sheet.

r_HAMU_CountByColor.label: Count by Color
r_HAMU_CountByColor.supertip: Count cells matching the sample cell's displayed fill color, including conditional formatting.

r_HAMU_CreateQRCode.label:
QR Code
Barcode
r_HAMU_CreateQRCode.supertip: Select QR Code or Barcode in one form; model choices follow the type. Supports text, links, email, phone, single values or a batch column. Batch codes go in empty cells to the right. Internet required; at most 250 codes.

r_HAMU_DataEntry.label: Data Entry
r_HAMU_DataEntry.supertip: Open Excel's native data form for the current table or contiguous list with unique headers; at most 32 columns.

r_HAMU_DataProfile.label: Data Profile
r_HAMU_DataProfile.supertip: Summarize the contents and data types of selected columns to help assess a dataset.

r_HAMU_DataQualityReport.label: Quality Report
r_HAMU_DataQualityReport.supertip: Inspect missing values, duplicates and data consistency. Review the report before deciding how to clean the source data.

r_HAMU_DateBuilder.label: Build Dates
r_HAMU_DateBuilder.supertip: Create dates from separate year, month and day fields.

r_HAMU_DateRangeList.label: Date List
r_HAMU_DateRangeList.supertip: Generate dates between a start and end date, optionally excluding weekends. Choose the output start cell.

r_HAMU_DeduplicateItems.label: Deduplicate Cell Items
r_HAMU_DeduplicateItems.supertip: Remove repeated items within each cell using the chosen separator, keeping their first occurrence.

r_HAMU_DeleteBlankCells.label: Delete Blanks
r_HAMU_DeleteBlankCells.supertip: Delete empty cells and shift remaining cells upward. Check related columns before changing their alignment.

r_HAMU_DeleteDropdowns.label: Remove Old Dropdown Objects
r_HAMU_DeleteDropdowns.supertip: Remove old worksheet dropdown objects while preserving cell data-validation lists.

r_HAMU_ExpandColumns.label: Fit Width
r_HAMU_ExpandColumns.supertip: Fit selected column widths to the content.

r_HAMU_ExportSheetsAsPDF.label: Save PDF
r_HAMU_ExportSheetsAsPDF.supertip: Save PDF using Select Range or Active Sheet. Select Range always opens Excel's range picker instead of automatically exporting the selection. Choose automatic, portrait or landscape.

r_HAMU_ExtractDigits.label: Extract Digits
r_HAMU_ExtractDigits.supertip: Extract numeric characters from selected text values.

r_HAMU_ExtractTextPart.label: Extract Text Part
r_HAMU_ExtractTextPart.supertip: Extract characters from the left/right or text before, after or between specified markers.

r_HAMU_ExtractUniqueList.label: Unique List
r_HAMU_ExtractUniqueList.supertip: Create a list of distinct values in a selected destination range or on a new worksheet. Configure the default destination behavior in Settings.

r_HAMU_FillBlanksZero.label: Fill Blanks with Zero
r_HAMU_FillBlanksZero.supertip: Write zero only to genuinely empty cells. Preserve populated cells and formulas returning empty text.

r_HAMU_FillDownBlanks.label: Fill Down Blanks
r_HAMU_FillDownBlanks.supertip: Fill blank cells with the nearest nonblank value above in the same column. Useful for repeated group labels in reports.

r_HAMU_FilterRowsToNewTable.label: Filter Rows
r_HAMU_FilterRowsToNewTable.supertip: Create an output table containing rows that satisfy the chosen column condition. Source data remains unchanged.

r_HAMU_FindMissingCombinations.label: Find Missing
r_HAMU_FindMissingCombinations.supertip: Find missing combinations of selected category columns.

r_HAMU_FolderIndex.label: Folder Contents
r_HAMU_FolderIndex.supertip: List files with hyperlinks, local paths, extensions, types, readable sizes and creation/modification dates. Choose current-folder or recursive scanning; large folder trees take longer.

r_HAMU_FormulaAudit.label: Formula Audit
r_HAMU_FormulaAudit.supertip: List formulas, source-cell links, displayed results, errors and direct external workbook references on a new sheet. Source formulas remain unchanged.

r_HAMU_GroupAndSummarize.label: Group and Summarize
r_HAMU_GroupAndSummarize.supertip: Group records by one or more key columns and summarize selected numeric fields. Specify column numbers or header names.

r_HAMU_HighlightByCriteria.label: Highlight Cell Types
r_HAMU_HighlightByCriteria.supertip: Highlight cells matching a selected type or criterion.

r_HAMU_InsertPhotosFromFolder.label:
Batch
Photos
r_HAMU_InsertPhotosFromFolder.supertip: Insert supported images from a folder into cells or over cells. In-cell conversion depends on Excel version support; over-cell images are constrained to cell bounds.

r_HAMU_LeadingZeros.label: Leading Zeros
r_HAMU_LeadingZeros.supertip: Add or remove leading zeros from text codes. Preserve source values and write the result as text.

r_HAMU_ListDefinedNames.label: List Defined Names
r_HAMU_ListDefinedNames.supertip: List workbook/worksheet names, references, visibility and broken references on a new sheet without modifying the names.

r_HAMU_ListLinks.label: List External Links
r_HAMU_ListLinks.supertip: List external Excel workbook links on a new worksheet.

r_HAMU_MaskData.label: Mask Data
r_HAMU_MaskData.supertip: Mask selected text according to the available options. Keep an original copy when required.

r_HAMU_MergeDuplicates.label: Merge Duplicate Records
r_HAMU_MergeDuplicates.supertip: Merge records by one or more key columns, sum selected numeric fields, keep the first nonblank value in other fields and include a record count.

r_HAMU_PatternFind.label: Find by Regular Expression
r_HAMU_PatternFind.supertip: Find text matching a regular-expression pattern and highlight matching cells. Use a preset or a custom pattern.

r_HAMU_PivotExport.label: Split Pivot
r_HAMU_PivotExport.supertip: Export separate PivotTable filter results to worksheets. Select a cell within the PivotTable first.

r_HAMU_PivotRowsToColumns.label: Pivot
r_HAMU_PivotRowsToColumns.supertip: Build a cross-tab by moving row categories into columns and summarizing values.

r_HAMU_RowStriping.label: Stripe Rows
r_HAMU_RowStriping.supertip: Apply alternating row colors to the selected area.

r_HAMU_SampleData.label: Sample Data
r_HAMU_SampleData.supertip: Create a sample of records using the requested sample size or selection options.

r_HAMU_SaveCopy.label: Save Copy
r_HAMU_SaveCopy.supertip: Save a copy at a chosen location, preserving the open workbook identity, unsaved state, file format and macros.

r_HAMU_SelectColumnsToNewTable.label: Copy Columns
r_HAMU_SelectColumnsToNewTable.supertip: Select columns by header names or positions such as 1,2,3 within the selected data. Whole-column sources are trimmed to populated rows.

r_HAMU_SelectSpecialCells.label: Select Special Cells
r_HAMU_SelectSpecialCells.supertip: Select formulas, constants, errors, blanks or visible cells within the current area. Do not change values or formatting.

r_HAMU_ShowHidden.label: Show Hidden Items
r_HAMU_ShowHidden.supertip: Reveal hidden sheets, rows or columns as supported by the command.

r_HAMU_ShuffleRows.label: Shuffle Rows
r_HAMU_ShuffleRows.supertip: Randomize the order of data rows while preserving values within each row.

r_HAMU_SmartAppendByHeaders.label: Smart Append
r_HAMU_SmartAppendByHeaders.supertip: Append worksheets by matching header names, even when column order differs. Missing columns remain blank. Add the source sheet name and preserve the source worksheets.

r_HAMU_SmartJoin.label: Join by Key
r_HAMU_SmartJoin.supertip: Match two datasets using selected key columns. Check key types, spaces and duplicates before choosing the fields to include.

r_HAMU_SplitByValueToFiles.label: Split to Files
r_HAMU_SplitByValueToFiles.supertip: Create separate files for distinct values in a selected column. Choose the destination folder and preserve the source data.

r_HAMU_SplitDataWizard.label: Split Data
r_HAMU_SplitDataWizard.supertip: Split values or datasets using the options shown in the dialog. Choose the source columns and desired output.

r_HAMU_SplitURLParameters.label: Extract URL
r_HAMU_SplitURLParameters.supertip: Extract URL query parameters into separate columns for analysis.

r_HAMU_StandardFormat.label: Number and Date Format
r_HAMU_StandardFormat.supertip: Apply integer number formatting or standard date formatting. Formatting controls display and does not automatically repair data types.

r_HAMU_StandardizeHeaders.label: Clean Headers
r_HAMU_StandardizeHeaders.supertip: Clean spaces and normalize column headings to a consistent naming scheme.

r_HAMU_SumByColor.label: Sum by Color
r_HAMU_SumByColor.supertip: Sum numeric values matching the sample cell's displayed fill color, including conditional formatting. Ignore blank, text and error values.

r_HAMU_TableTotals.label: Total Row
r_HAMU_TableTotals.supertip: Toggle the active table total row and sum numeric columns.

r_HAMU_Transfer.label: Transfer
r_HAMU_Transfer.supertip: Transfer LAMBDA definitions, cell styles, named data ranges, sheet data and Excel tables. Sheet/table transfer copies values and formatting, without VBA.

r_HAMU_UDFHelp.label: Worksheet Functions
r_HAMU_UDFHelp.supertip: Show the eight HAMU worksheet functions with examples. Function names remain unchanged when switching language.

r_HAMU_UnmergeAndFill.label: Unmerge and Fill
r_HAMU_UnmergeAndFill.supertip: Unmerge cells and fill the resulting area with the original merged value.

r_HAMU_UnpivotColumnsToRows.label: Unpivot
r_HAMU_UnpivotColumnsToRows.supertip: Convert wide columns into field/value rows. Keep text headers such as 2026.01 as text.

r_UDF_GizliLink.label: HAMU_GizliLink
r_UDF_GizliLink.supertip: =HAMU_GizliLink(A1) | Return the first hyperlink address in the cell.

r_UDF_LambdaMultiLookup.label: HAMU_L_CokluAra
r_UDF_LambdaMultiLookup.supertip: Exact lookup across two key/result pairs, returning the first match. Example: =HAMU_L_CokluAra(G2;A2:A10;B2:B10;D2:D10;E2:E10). Transfer it from the LAMBDA template; Microsoft 365/Excel 2024 required.

r_UDF_LambdaMultiSum.label: HAMU_L_CokluTopla
r_UDF_LambdaMultiSum.supertip: Sum matching values across two key/value pairs. Example: =HAMU_L_CokluTopla(G2;A2:A10;B2:B10;D2:D10;E2:E10). Transfer from the template; Microsoft 365/Excel 2024 required.

r_UDF_LambdaUniqueMerge.label: HAMU_L_BenzersizBirlestir
r_UDF_LambdaUniqueMerge.supertip: Combine nonblank values from two areas into a sorted unique list. Example: =HAMU_L_BenzersizBirlestir(A2:B10;D2:E10). Requires a blank spill area and Microsoft 365/Excel 2024.

r_UDF_LinkParamDegeri.label: HAMU_LinkParamDegeri
r_UDF_LinkParamDegeri.supertip: =HAMU_LinkParamDegeri(A1;"id") | Return the value of the specified URL query parameter.

r_UDF_RengeGoreSay.label: HAMU_RengeGoreSay
r_UDF_RengeGoreSay.supertip: =HAMU_RengeGoreSay(A1:A20;B1) | Count cells with the same direct fill color as B1. Recalculate with F9 after changing formatting.

r_UDF_RenklileriTopla.label: HAMU_RengeGoreTopla
r_UDF_RenklileriTopla.supertip: =HAMU_RengeGoreTopla(A1:A20;B1) | Sum numbers with the same direct fill color as B1. Recalculate with F9 after changing formatting.

r_UDF_SayidanMetine.label: HAMU_SayidanMetine
r_UDF_SayidanMetine.supertip: =HAMU_SayidanMetine(123) | Spell numbers in Turkish. Supports absolute values below 15 digits and reads decimal digits individually. The output language stays Turkish.

r_UDF_TablodanVeriGetir.label: HAMU_TablodanVeriGetir
r_UDF_TablodanVeriGetir.supertip: =HAMU_TablodanVeriGetir(A1;"Tablo1";"Kod";"Ad") | Return the first matching value from a table in the workbook containing the formula.

r_UDF_URLDecode.label: HAMU_URLCoz
r_UDF_URLDecode.supertip: =HAMU_URLCoz(A1) | Decode UTF-8 URL characters; preserve invalid percent sequences.

r_UDF_YerelDosyaYolu.label: HAMU_YerelDosyaYolu
r_UDF_YerelDosyaYolu.supertip: =HAMU_YerelDosyaYolu(A1) | Map a personal OneDrive URL to a local path using the local OneDrive environment variable; preserve other URL types.

settingsCenter.label: Settings
settingsCenter.helperText: Manage language, registration locations and trading preferences from this center.

settingsStorage.label: Preferences belong to this Windows user and do not change other workbooks' settings.

textSub1.label: Regular Expressions
textSub1.supertip: Find, extract or replace text using regular expressions. Use examples or a custom pattern.

textSub2.label: Cell Layout
textSub2.supertip: Tools for cell layout, number and date formats, and column widths.
